EHDSMedicationDispense 0..*EHDSDataSetMedication dispense model.

Elements defined in Ancestors:header
header 1..1BaseDispensation header.
identifier 1..*IdentifierBusiness identifier for the dispensation.
author[x] 1..*EHDSHealthProfessional, EHDSOrganisation, EHDSDeviceAuthor of the document.
date 1..1dateTimeDate and time of issuing the dispense record.
status 1..1CodeableConceptThe status of the dispense, e.g. completed, declined, entered-in-error.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: HL7 Medication Dispense Status Codes
language 0..1CodeableConceptLanguage in which the document is written. Language is expressed by the IETF language tag.
dispenseLocation 0..1EHDSOrganisationLocation of dispense.
receiver[x] 0..1Identification of the person who received the dispensed medicinal products, especially when it was not the patient. When not present, it is assumed that the patient is the receiver.
receiverEHDSPatientEHDSPatient
receiverEHDSHealthProfessionalEHDSHealthProfessional
receiverEHDSRelatedPersonEHDSRelatedPerson
relatedRequest 1..*IdentifierIdentifier of the prescription item the dispense is related to.
medication 1..1EHDSMedicationExact dispensed product. If multiple medicinal products are dispensed together, multiple dispense records should be created.
dispensedQuantity 1..1QuantityNumber of dispensed packages if the package size is known, or number of smaller items/units, according to the medicinal product dispensed. A unit shall be provided.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM for units of measurement, EDQM Standard Terms for units of presentation
substitutionOccurred 0..1booleanWhether substitution was made by the dispenser. Definition of substitution is specific to the jurisdiction.
dosageInstructions 0..1EHDSDosageDosage and administration instructions for the dispensed medicinal product. These instructions may deviate from the instructions included in the prescription.
note 0..1stringAdditional information or comments.
